name: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit - Super Bundle
summary: This bundle includes a digital license for Need for Speed Hot Pursuit and all of the downloadable content for Need for Speed Hot Pursuit: Racer Time Saver, SCPD Time Saver, SCPD Rebel Racer Pack, Super Sports Pack, Armed & Dangerous Pack, Lamborghini Untamed Pack, and Porsche Unleashed Pack.
